claims.object_text: candidate tumor suppressor WW domain-containing oxidoreductase protein
claims.quote: encodes a candidate tumor suppressor WW domain-containing oxidoreductase protein.
This gene is located on a common fragile site FRA16D.

claims.object_text: TNF, chemotherapeutic drugs, UV irradiation, Wnt, TGF-β, C1q, Hyal-2, sex steroid hormones signaling pathways
claims.quote: WWOX participates in a variety of cellular events and acts as a transducer in the many signal pathways, including TNF, chemotherapeutic drugs, UV irradiation, Wnt, TGF-β, C1q, Hyal-2, sex steroid hormones, and others.

claims.object_text: restricts relocation of transcription factors to the nucleus for suppressing cancer survival
claims.quote: transiently overexpressed WWOX restricts relocation of transcription factors to the nucleus for suppressing cancer survival
play a crucial role in neural development and in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease and neuronal injury.

claims.object_text: epilepsy, mental retardation, and brain developmental defects
claims.quote: participate in the development of epilepsy, mental retardation, and brain developmental defects in mice, rats and humans.
